Product Highlights
Space-Saving Compression: Helps reduce storage volume for clothes, bedding, and soft items
Reusable & Durable: Designed for multiple uses with strong sealing technology
Two Types Available: Hand Pump Vacuum Bags & Hand Roll Vacuum Bags
Travel & Home Friendly: Suitable for wardrobes, luggage, and storage boxes
Easy to Use: Simple air-removal process with pump or rolling method
Organized Storage: Helps keep items neat and protected from dust


Detailed Description
Maximize your storage space with our Reusable Vacuum Storage Bags, designed to help compress bulky clothing, bedding, and soft items for easier organization. Ideal for both home storage and travel, these bags help reduce volume while keeping items neatly packed.
Available in hand pump vacuum bags and hand roll vacuum bags, this set offers flexible solutions for different needs—whether at home, in the wardrobe, or on the go.


Key Features
Material: High-quality PA + PE plastic
Design: Double-zip seal with air-valve system
Color: Transparent bag
Reusable: Suitable for repeated use with proper care


How It Works
Hand Pump Vacuum Bags: Place items inside, seal the zip, and use the hand pump to remove air through the valve.
Hand Roll Vacuum Bags: Insert items, seal the zip, then roll the bag to push air out—no pump required.
Both methods help compress items to save storage space efficiently.


Benefits
Helps optimize wardrobe, luggage, and storage space
Suitable for travel, seasonal storage, and home organization
No electricity required
Lightweight and easy to store when not in use

items.desc_detail: [{"type":"text","text":"Product Description:"},{"type":"text","text":"This advanced automatic soap dispenser and sanitizer, designed for modern hygiene standards, integrates dual temperature-sensing technology, enabling both upper and lower sensor modules to detect hand temperature for enhanced user feedback. Its innovative smart induction system delivers precise doses of liquid, gel, or foam, with easy customization of output levels. The 1080ml capacity and flexible power options (DC 5V or 3 AA batteries) make it suitable for high-traffic areas."},{"type":"text","text":"With multi-language support in 15 languages, including English, Chinese, and Spanish, it’s accessible globally. The device is optimized for efficient energy consumption, equipped with a low-power system that minimizes environmental impact. Mount it on a wall, tabletop, or tripod to accommodate various installation needs. The dispenser is suitable for liquid disinfectant, gel, or soap, ensuring adaptability for different hand hygiene applications."},{"type":"text","text":" "},{"type":"text","text":"Operating Instructions:"},{"type":"ul","content":["Power On/Off: Long press the power button to turn the machine on or off.","Adjust Liquid Output: Press the power button twice to enter the liquid output level settings. liquid."]},{"type":"text","text":"Tips:"},{"type":"ul","content":["Read Instructions Carefully: Before using, thoroughly read the user manual.","Filling Precaution: Use a funnel to prevent liquid from
